# DigitalOcean App Platform spec for Moto Pass.
#
# One Node service serves the built SPA and /api on the same origin, backed by a
# managed PostgreSQL 18 dev-tier cluster. Applied with:
#
#   doctl apps update <app-id> --spec app.yaml
#
# The cluster is NOT declared here. A `databases:` block in the spec returns 403
# forbidden on this account even with database create scope, so the cluster is
# created out of band and its URI is set as the DATABASE_URL secret:
#
#   doctl databases create motopass-db --engine pg --version 18 --region nyc1 \
#     --size db-s-1vcpu-1gb --num-nodes 1
#   doctl databases db create <cluster-id> motopass
#   doctl databases user create <cluster-id> motopass
#   doctl databases firewalls append <cluster-id> --rule ip_addr:<this box> \
#     --rule app:<app-id>
#   (then, as doadmin, ALTER DATABASE motopass OWNER TO motopass; ALTER SCHEMA
#    public OWNER TO motopass; -- PG 18 gives a new normal user no CREATE on public)
#
# This replaces the two-component shape the console's GitHub detector created
# (moto-pass-client + moto-pass-server), which failed at launch with
# "determine start command: when there is no default process a command is
# required": a Vite app has no start script, so its component had no process
# to launch. One component that builds both apps is the shape this repo wants.
#
# Secrets are left unset here (type: SECRET) and set once in the console or by
# applying a copy of this file with real values — never in git.
#
# Signing up mails a confirmation link (server/src/services/mail.service.ts), and
# an account cannot sign in until it is opened. Mail goes out over Resend when
# its key is present — that is the supported path; SMTP is the fallback.
#
# The key path follows NODE_ENV (same shape as the Spaces credentials): a
# development process reads RESEND_API_KEY_DEV and this production service reads
# RESEND_API_KEY_PROD. The two keys are never interchangeable — a deploy with
# only the dev key prints messages instead of sending them, and says so at boot.
# Set these in the app's console environment or no rider can finish a signup:
#
#   RESEND_API_KEY_PROD  from the Resend dashboard (Domains must show the sending
#                        domain verified, or every send is refused 403)
#   MAIL_FROM_PROD       "Moto Pass <no-reply@yourdomain>" on that verified domain
#                        (falls back to MAIL_FROM when unset)
#   MAIL_REPLY_TO        optional; where a rider's reply lands
#   APP_PUBLIC_URL_PROD  https://yourdomain — the origin every confirm/reset link
#                        points at. The dev origin (APP_PUBLIC_URL_DEV) is never
#                        read here. Falls back to CORS_ORIGIN, then
#                        localhost:5180, so a deploy without it mails dead links.
#
# Verify with: cd server && npx tsx scripts/probe-mail.ts you@example.com
# (locally that exercises the dev key; lead with NODE_ENV=production to exercise
# the live one. On SMTP only instead: SMTP_HOST smtp.resend.com / SMTP_PORT 587 /
# SMTP_USER resend / SMTP_PASS <the same API key>.)

name: king-prawn-app
region: nyc

features:
  - buildpack-stack=ubuntu-22

services:
  # Name kept from the component the console created: App Platform treats a
  # rename as a create + delete, and that needs app create scope on the token.
  - name: moto-pass-server
    environment_slug: node-js
    instance_count: 1
    instance_size_slug: basic-xxs # $5/mo, 512MB RAM
    http_port: 8080
    # The service needs both apps' build output, so the source is the repo root.
    source_dir: /
    github:
      repo: jacoblbagent/moto-pass
      branch: main
      deploy_on_push: true
    build_command: |
      # --include=dev because the build compiles TypeScript and Vite, and
      # NODE_ENV=production would otherwise skip those dev dependencies.
      cd server && npm ci --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npm run build && \
      cd ../client && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
    # Root-relative on purpose: no `cd`, so the command is valid whatever working
    # directory the launcher hands us. Paths inside the server resolve off __dirname.
    run_command: node server/dist/index.js
    health_check:
      http_path: /api/health
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 20
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 6
    envs:
      # The platform router cannot reach a loopback binding, so HOST must be 0.0.0.0.
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
        # RUN_TIME only: at build time it makes npm skip the dev dependencies
        # that tsc and vite come from, so the build dies with "tsc: not found".
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: HOST
        value: 0.0.0.0
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: PORT
        value: "8080"
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: QR_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
        value: "60"
        scope: RUN_TIME
      # Set out of band to the managed cluster's URI (see the note at the top).
      # Left unset here so no password lands in git.
      - key: DATABASE_URL
        scope: RUN_TIME
        type: SECRET
      - key: SESSION_SECRET
        scope: RUN_TIME
        type: SECRET
      - key: QR_SIGNING_SECRET
        scope: RUN_TIME
        type: SECRET
      # Production media is intentionally unset until its own Space exists.
      # Never put development bucket settings on this production service.
      - key: MEDIA_STORAGE
        value: local
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: SPACES_REGION
        value: nyc3
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: SPACES_PROD_BUCKET
        value: ""
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: SPACES_PROD_PUBLIC_BASE
        value: ""
        scope: RUN_TIME
      # Add SPACES_PROD_KEY and SPACES_PROD_SECRET as runtime secrets when ready,
      # then set MEDIA_STORAGE=spaces. No development credentials belong here.
      # Production mail. The live key only: the service reads RESEND_API_KEY_PROD
      # and ignores the dev one, so an unset value here prints messages instead of
      # sending them with the wrong account. Set the value in the console.
      - key: RESEND_API_KEY_PROD
        scope: RUN_TIME
        type: SECRET
      - key: MAIL_FROM_PROD
        value: ""
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: MAIL_REPLY_TO
        value: ""
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: SEED_DEFAULT_PASSWORD
        scope: RUN_TIME
        type: SECRET

jobs:
  # The managed cluster starts empty: there are no migration files in this repo
  # (the schema step is `prisma db push`), so without this job every Prisma read
  # 500s and the network page renders "No partner tracks yet." over a map with
  # no pins. Runs before each deploy; `seed-if-empty` only seeds a database with
  # zero tracks, so redeploys keep the demo's sessions and redemptions.
  - name: motopass-migrate
    kind: PRE_DEPLOY
    instance_size_slug: basic-xxs
    instance_count: 1
    source_dir: /
    github:
      repo: jacoblbagent/moto-pass
      branch: main
    build_command: cd server && npm ci --include=dev
    run_command: >-
      cd server && npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss &&
      npx tsx scripts/seed-if-empty.ts
    envs:
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: DATABASE_URL
        value: ${motopass.DATABASE_URL}
        scope: RUN_TIME
      - key: SEED_DEFAULT_PASSWORD
        scope: RUN_TIME
        type: SECRET

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Moto Pass — home page proposal</title>

  <!-- Proposal only: a restyle of the Moto Pass landing page in the Astryx
       register. Served by the dev server at :5180/landing-astryx.html, reads the
       same public API the real page reads (/tracks?terms=public, /tiers), so
       every figure on it is counted at render time rather than typed. It lives
       at the client root, never under public/, so a build cannot ship it. -->

  <!-- Figtree is the reference system's own body and heading face. -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
    rel="stylesheet"
  />

  <style>
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
       Tokens. The geometry, the type scale, the surfaces and the state
       colours are the reference system's own values; the accent is Moto
       Pass's orange, carried on the same accent / on-accent / tint trio.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    :root {
      color-scheme: dark;

      --body: #111112;
      --surface: #1f1f22;
      --popover: #28292c;
      --line: rgba(242, 244, 246, 0.10);
      --line-strong: #494d53;

      --ink: #e7eaed;
      --ink-2: #aaafb5;
      --ink-3: #6f747c;

      --accent: #ff8a3f;
      --accent-strong: #eb6e00;
      --accent-tint: rgba(242, 121, 2, 0.20);
      --accent-ink: #0a1317;

      --ok: #24bb5e;
      --ok-ink: #a5f690;
      --ok-tint: rgba(36, 187, 94, 0.20);
      --warn: #e9af08;
      --warn-ink: #fbce03;
      --warn-tint: rgba(226, 164, 0, 0.22);

      --chip-bg: #d6d3d1;
      --chip-ink: #1c1917;

      --r-inner: 8px;
      --r-element: 12px;
      --r-container: 16px;
      --r-page: 32px;
      --r-pill: 999px;

      --fs-xs: 13px;
      --fs-sm: 14px;
      --fs-base: 16px;
      --fs-lg: 20px;
      --fs-xl: 25px;
      --fs-2xl: 31px;
      --fs-3xl: 39px;
      --fs-4xl: 49px;

      --s-1: 6px;
      --s-2: 12px;
      --s-3: 18px;
      --s-4: 24px;
      --s-5: 30px;
      --s-6: 36px;
      --s-8: 48px;
      --s-10: 60px;
      --s-12: 72px;

      --e-fast: 100ms;
      --e-med: 250ms;
      --shadow-med: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      --shadow-high: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), 0 12px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);

      --header-h: 64px;
      --shell: 1240px;
    }

    :root[data-theme='light'] {
      color-scheme: light;

      --body: #f1f4f7;
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --popover: #ffffff;
      --line: rgba(5, 54, 89, 0.10);
      --line-strong: #ccd3db;

      --ink: #0a1317;
      --ink-2: #4e606f;
      --ink-3: #a4b0bc;

      --accent: #eb6e00;
      --accent-strong: #b34a01;
      --accent-tint: rgba(242, 121, 2, 0.14);
      --accent-ink: #ffffff;

      --ok: #0d8626;
      --ok-ink: #09441f;
      --ok-tint: rgba(36, 187, 94, 0.16);
      --warn: #c58600;
      --warn-ink: #753f07;
      --warn-tint: rgba(226, 164, 0, 0.18);

      --shadow-med: 0 2px 4px rgba(5, 54, 89, 0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(5, 54, 89, 0.10);
      --shadow-high: 0 4px 6px rgba(5, 54, 89, 0.08), 0 12px 24px rgba(5, 54, 89, 0.14);
    }

    /* Base layer. */
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--body);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-family: Figtree, 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      font-size: var(--fs-base);
      line-height: 1.5;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      transition: background var(--e-med) ease;
    }

    /* Browser surfaces, themed from the palette. */
    ::selection { background: var(--accent-tint); color: var(--ink); }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-inner); }
    * { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-pill); }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    p { margin: 0; }
    h1, h2, h3 { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    .tnum { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    .shell { width: 100%; max-width: var(--shell); margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--s-6); }

    .skip {
      position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink);
      padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-element); font-weight: 600;
    }
    .skip:focus { left: var(--s-4); top: var(--s-3); }

    /* Controls: pills at the reference system's 40px element height. */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2);
      height: 40px; padding: 0 var(--s-4);
      border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
      font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      transition: opacity var(--e-fast) ease, background-color var(--e-fast) ease;
    }
    .btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
    .btn-accent { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
    .btn-quiet { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
    .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong); }
    .btn-sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--s-3); font-size: var(--fs-xs); }
    .btn-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; justify-content: center; padding: 0; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); }
    .btn-icon:hover { background: var(--surface); opacity: 1; }
    .btn svg { flex: none; }

    /* Status chips and count chips. */
    .pill {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
      font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .pill-open { background: var(--ok-tint); color: var(--ok-ink); }
    .pill-hold { background: var(--warn-tint); color: var(--warn-ink); }
    .pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: currentColor; flex: none; }
    /* Counts wear the house chip: stone ground, 4px radius. */
    .count-chip {
      display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
      background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--chip-ink);
      font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    /* Header: rides over the page, takes its surface once the page moves. */
    .site-head {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
      height: var(--header-h);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--body) 88%, transparent);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    .head-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-6); height: var(--header-h); }
    .brand { font-size: var(--fs-lg); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .brand span { color: var(--accent); }
    .head-nav { display: flex; gap: var(--s-4); }
    .head-nav a { font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--ink-2); transition: color var(--e-fast) ease; }
    .head-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
    .head-end { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); }

    /* Hero: one screen, solid ground, the photograph as a page-radius panel
       with real components floating over its edges. */
    .hero {
      min-height: calc(100svh - var(--header-h));
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
      padding: var(--s-6) 0 var(--s-8);
    }
    .hero-copy { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto var(--s-6); text-align: center; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: var(--fs-4xl); max-width: 22ch; margin-inline: auto; }
    .hero-lede {
      margin: var(--s-4) auto 0; max-width: 62ch;
      font-size: var(--fs-lg); color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    .hero-acts { display: flex; gap: var(--s-2); justify-content: center; margin-top: var(--s-6); }
    .hero-live {
      margin-top: var(--s-5);
      display: flex; gap: var(--s-4); justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
      font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    .hero-live span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-1); }
    .live-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--ok); }

    .stage { position: relative; }
    .stage-photo {
      border-radius: var(--r-page); overflow: hidden;
      height: clamp(320px, 50svh, 480px); background: var(--surface);
    }
    .stage-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 42%; }

    /* Floating layers: elevation instead of an edge, per the depth rule. Two
       hang off the left edge, one off the right, so the pair reads level. */
    .float {
      position: absolute; width: 268px;
      background: var(--surface); border-radius: var(--r-container);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-high);
      padding: var(--s-3);
      animation: rise 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
    }
    .float-venue { left: -36px; top: 24px; animation-delay: 60ms; }
    .float-days { left: -36px; bottom: 24px; animation-delay: 140ms; }
    .float-pass { right: -36px; top: 44%; animation-delay: 100ms; }

    @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .float { animation: none; } }

    .float-label { font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .float-thumb { border-radius: var(--r-element); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; margin-bottom: var(--s-2); }
    .float-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .float-title { font-size: var(--fs-base); font-weight: 600; }
    .float-sub { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--ink-2); }
    .float-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); margin-top: var(--s-2); }
    .float-row.between { justify-content: space-between; }

    /* The pass card's identity row and its day meter. */
    .rider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); }
    .rider img { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: var(--r-inner); }
    .rider-name { font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; }
    .rider-where { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--ink-2); }
    .meter { display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; }
    .meter i {
      display: block; width: 26px; height: 8px; border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--accent);
    }
    .meter i.spent { background: var(--line-strong); }
    .pass-facts { margin-top: var(--s-2); display: grid; gap: 5px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--ink-2); }
    .pass-facts b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

    /* Bands. The wide band is a page-radius surface on the body ground. */
    .band { padding: var(--s-12) 0; }
    .band-surface {
      background: var(--surface);
      border-radius: var(--r-page);
      padding: var(--s-12) 0;
      margin: var(--s-4) 0;
    }
    .band-head { max-width: 720px; }
    .band h2 { font-size: var(--fs-3xl); }
    .band-lede { margin-top: var(--s-3); font-size: var(--fs-lg); color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 60ch; }

    /* Fact rows: a hairline dl, label left, figure right. */
    .facts { margin: var(--s-6) 0 0; display: grid; gap: 0; }
    .facts div {
      display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--s-4);
      padding: var(--s-2) 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .facts dt { font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--ink-2); }
    .facts dd { margin: 0; font-size: var(--fs-lg); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    /* The wall: a frame per partner venue, no card material. */
    .wall-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--s-4); margin-top: var(--s-10); }
    .wall-head h3 { font-size: var(--fs-lg); }
    .wall {
      margin-top: var(--s-4);
      display: grid; gap: var(--s-3);
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(212px, 1fr));
    }
    .tile { display: block; }
    .tile-shot { display: block; border-radius: var(--r-element); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--body); }
    .tile-shot img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .tile-cap { padding-top: var(--s-2); display: grid; gap: 5px; }
    .tile-name { font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; }
    .tile-where { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--ink-2); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); flex-wrap: wrap; }

    /* The pass, held. One card beside the terms it carries. */

    .billing { display: inline-flex; margin-top: var(--s-5); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

  <script type="module">
    /* The page reads the same public API the app's landing reads, so every
       figure and frame below is counted at render time. If the API is not up
       the page says so rather than printing a cached number. */
    const money = (cents) =>
      '$' + (cents % 100 === 0 ? (cents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US') : (cents / 100).toFixed(2));

    /** A venue's display name without the facility suffix the tiles can't hold. */
    const shortName = (name) =>
      name
        .replace(' Motocross Park', '')
        .replace(' Motor Sports Park', '')
        .replace(' Raceway', '')
        .replace(' MX Park', '')
        .replace(/^The /, '');

    const statusPill = (t) =>
      t.status === 'OPEN'
        ? '<span class="pill pill-open"><i class="pill-dot"></i>Open</span>'
        : '<span class="pill pill-hold"><i class="pill-dot"></i>Weather hold</span>';

    const tick = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 8.5 6.5 12 13 4.5"/></svg>`;

    let tracks = [];
    let tiers = [];

    try {
      const [tRes, pRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/tracks?terms=public').then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch('/api/tiers').then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      tracks = tRes.data?.tracks ?? [];
      tiers = pRes.data?.tiers ?? [];
    } catch {
      tracks = [];
    }

    /* The live read. The included-days span, the open count and the states are
       all counted off the network read, the way the app's landing counts them. */
    const days = tracks.map((t) => t.includedDays ?? 0).filter((n) => n > 0);
    const net = {
      count: tracks.length,
      open: tracks.filter((t) => t.status === 'OPEN').length,
      states: new Set(tracks.map((t) => t.region)).size,
      dayMin: days.length ? Math.min(...days) : null,
      dayMax: days.length ? Math.max(...days) : null,
      dayTotal: days.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
    };

    if (!net.count) {
      document.getElementById('hero-lede').textContent =
        'The network read is not available on this port. Start the API on 4010 and reload.';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('hero-lede').textContent =
        'One pass covers every partner track in the network.';

      document.getElementById('hero-live').innerHTML = `
        <span><i class="live-dot"></i>${net.open} of ${net.count} tracks open today</span>
        <span>${net.dayMin} to ${net.dayMax} included days at every track</span>
        <span>${net.states} states</span>`;
    }

    /* Fact rows, hairline by hairline. */
    const facts = [
      ['Partner tracks', net.count],
      ['States', net.states],
      ['Included days per track', `${net.dayMin} to ${net.dayMax}`],
      ['Ride days across the network', net.dayTotal],
      ['Open today', `${net.open} of ${net.count}`],
    ];
    document.getElementById('facts').innerHTML = facts
      .map(([k, v]) => `<div><dt>${k}</dt><dd>${v}</dd></div>`)
      .join('');

    /* The wall: most included days first, open venues ahead of the rest. */
    const wall = [...tracks].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        (b.includedDays ?? 0) - (a.includedDays ?? 0) ||
        (a.status === 'OPEN' ? 0 : 1) - (b.status === 'OPEN' ? 0 : 1) ||
        a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
    );
    document.getElementById('wall').innerHTML = wall
      .map(
        (t) => `
        <a class="tile" href="/tracks/${t.slug}">
          <span class="tile-shot"><img src="${t.imageUrl ?? ''}" alt="" loading="lazy" /></span>
          <span class="tile-cap">
            <span class="tile-name">${shortName(t.name)}</span>
            <span class="tile-where">${t.region}${t.includedDays != null ? ` · <span class="count-chip">${t.includedDays} days</span>` : ''}</span>
            ${statusPill(t)}
          </span>
        </a>`,
      )
      .join('');
    document.getElementById('wall-note').innerHTML =
      `<span class="count-chip">${net.count}</span> venues · <span class="count-chip">${net.open}</span> open today`;

    /* The floats carry the picked venue's own live read, not a mock-up. */
    const hero = wall.find((t) => t.status === 'OPEN' && t.hours) ?? wall[0];
    if (hero) {
      document.getElementById('float-venue').innerHTML = `
        <span class="float-thumb"><img src="${hero.imageUrl ?? ''}" alt="" /></span>
        <div class="float-title">${shortName(hero.name)}</div>
        <div class="float-sub">${hero.city}, ${hero.region} · ${hero.hours}</div>
        <div class="float-row">${statusPill(hero)}<span class="float-label">${hero.nextEvent ?? ''}</span></div>`;

      const extra = hero.extraDayPriceCents
        ? money(Math.round(hero.extraDayPriceCents * (1 - (hero.discountRate ?? 0))))
        : null;
      document.getElementById('float-days').innerHTML = `
        <div class="float-row between">
          <span class="float-label">Days left at ${shortName(hero.name)}</span>
          <span class="count-chip">${hero.includedDays} of ${hero.includedDays}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="float-row">
          <span class="meter">${'<i></i>'.repeat(hero.includedDays ?? 0)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pass-facts">
          <span>Day ${hero.discountDayNumber ?? ''} at half price${extra ? `, <b>${extra}</b>` : ''}</span>
        </div>`;
    }

    /* The pass card, held by a seeded rider. */
    document.getElementById('float-pass').innerHTML = `
      <div class="rider">
        <img src="/avatars/alex.svg" alt="" />
        <div>
          <div class="rider-name">Alex Rivera</div>
          <div class="rider-where">Asheville, NC</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pass-facts"><span>Season pass · valid to December 31</span></div>`;

    /* What the pass includes: the tier's own copy, then the counted allotment. */
    document.getElementById('carries').innerHTML = [
      `${net.dayMin} to ${net.dayMax} included days at all ${net.count} partner tracks`,
      `${net.dayTotal} ride days across the network per season`,
      'Extra days at the gate, discounted from the sticker price',
      'Season rider perks from partner brands',
      'Every venue\u2019s status, hours and events, all year',
    ]
      .map((line) => `<li>${tick}<span>${line}</span></li>`)
      .join('');

    /* Tiers, on the pricing page's own presale rule: the reduced annual figure
       sells the card and names the list price it replaces. */
    const term = { value: 'annual' };
    const annualPrice = (t) =>
      t.earlyBirdPriceCents != null ? t.earlyBirdPriceCents : t.priceCents;

    function renderTiers() {
      const sellable = tiers.filter((t) => t.isActive);
      const annualSavePct = (() => {
        const paid = tiers.find((t) => !t.isDefault && t.monthlyPriceCents != null);
        if (!paid) return 0;
        return Math.round((1 - annualPrice(paid) / (paid.monthlyPriceCents * 12)) * 100);
      })();

      document.getElementById('tiers').innerHTML = sellable
        .map((t) => {
          const monthly = term.value === 'monthly' && !t.isDefault && t.monthlyPriceCents != null;
          const presale = !t.isDefault && !monthly && t.earlyBirdPriceCents != null;
          const off = presale ? t.priceCents - t.earlyBirdPriceCents : 0;
          const cents = monthly ? t.monthlyPriceCents : annualPrice(t);
          const lines = t.isDefault
            ? [
                'Every partner track, with its live status and hours',
                'Follow the tracks you ride, and unfollow any time',
                'Upgrade mid-season, with the days applying right away',
              ]
            : [
                'All free pass attributes',
                '2 included days at every partner track',
                'An extra day at half price',
                'Walk-up entry at every venue in the network',
              ];

          return `
          <div class="tier${t.slug === 'base' ? ' popular' : t.isDefault ? ' free' : ''}">
            <h3>${t.name}</h3>
            <div class="price-row">
              ${off > 0 ? `<s class="was tnum">${money(t.priceCents)}</s>` : ''}
              <span class="amount tnum">${money(cents)}</span>
              <span class="unit">${monthly ? 'per month' : 'per year'}</span>
            </div>
            ${off > 0 ? `<p class="price-off">Presale ends Dec 2nd, save <b>${money(off)}</b>!</p>` : ''}
            <a class="btn ${t.isDefault ? 'btn-quiet' : 'btn-accent'}" href="${t.isDefault ? '/signup' : '/pricing'}">
              ${t.isDefault ? 'Create free account' : 'Get the pass'}
            </a>
            <div class="tier-rule"></div>
            <p class="tier-includes">Includes:</p>
            <div class="tier-list">
              ${lines.map((l) => `<span class="tick">${tick}<span>${l}</span></span>`).join('')}
            </div>
          </div>`;
        })
        .join('');

  <script type="module">
    /* Every figure below is counted off the same two public reads the real
       /pricing page makes. Nothing here types a number. */
    const money = (cents) =>
      '$' + (cents % 100 === 0 ? (cents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US') : (cents / 100).toFixed(2));

    const tick = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 8.5 6.5 12 13 4.5"/></svg>`;

    let tracks = [];
    let tiers = [];

    try {
      const [tRes, pRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/tracks?terms=public').then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch('/api/tiers').then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      tracks = tRes.data?.tracks ?? [];
      tiers = pRes.data?.tiers ?? [];
    } catch {
      tracks = [];
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------ the read */

    const withDays = tracks.filter((t) => (t.includedDays ?? 0) > 0);
    const dayCounts = withDays.map((t) => t.includedDays);
    const sticker = tracks.map((t) => t.extraDayPriceCents).filter((c) => c != null);

    const net = {
      count: tracks.length,
      open: tracks.filter((t) => t.status === 'OPEN').length,
      states: new Set(tracks.map((t) => t.region)).size,
      dayMin: dayCounts.length ? Math.min(...dayCounts) : null,
      dayMax: dayCounts.length ? Math.max(...dayCounts) : null,
      dayTotal: dayCounts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
      stickerMin: sticker.length ? Math.min(...sticker) : null,
      stickerMax: sticker.length ? Math.max(...sticker) : null,
    };
    const rateMax = tracks.reduce((m, t) => Math.max(m, t.discountRate ?? 0), 0);
    const rateMin = tracks.reduce((m, t) => Math.min(m, t.discountRate ?? 1), 1);

    /* Cost of the network's included days bought one at a time at the venues'
       own sticker prices, against the pass. */
    const gateLow = net.stickerMin != null ? net.dayTotal * net.stickerMin : null;
    const gateHigh = net.stickerMax != null ? net.dayTotal * net.stickerMax : null;
    const memberLow = net.stickerMin != null ? net.stickerMin * (1 - rateMax) : null;
    const memberHigh = net.stickerMax != null ? net.stickerMax * (1 - rateMin) : null;

    const paid = tiers.find((t) => !t.isDefault) ?? null;
    const free = tiers.find((t) => t.isDefault) ?? null;

    const presaleOpen = paid?.earlyBirdPriceCents != null;
    const annualNow = paid
      ? presaleOpen
        ? paid.earlyBirdPriceCents
        : paid.priceCents
      : null;
    const offCents = paid && presaleOpen ? paid.priceCents - paid.earlyBirdPriceCents : 0;
    const monthlyYear = paid?.monthlyPriceCents != null ? paid.monthlyPriceCents * 12 : null;
    const annualSavePct =
      paid?.monthlyPriceCents != null && annualNow != null
        ? Math.max(0, Math.round((1 - annualNow / monthlyYear) * 100))
        : 0;
    const vsMonthly = monthlyYear != null && annualNow != null ? monthlyYear - annualNow : 0;

    if (!net.count || !paid) {
      document.getElementById('hero-live').textContent =
        'The pricing read is not available on this port. Start the API on 4010 and reload.';
    }

    /* Headline count, so the h1 follows the network. */
    document.getElementById('h1-tracks').textContent = String(net.count || '25');

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------- the hero */

    document.getElementById('hero-live').innerHTML = net.count
      ? `<i class="live-dot"></i>${net.open} of ${net.count} tracks open today`
      : '';

    document.getElementById('hero-facts').innerHTML = net.count
      ? [
          ['Ride days included', String(net.dayTotal)],
          ['At every track', net.dayMin === net.dayMax ? `${net.dayMin} days` : `${net.dayMin} to ${net.dayMax} days`],
          ['States', String(net.states)],
          ['Extra day', `${Math.round(rateMin * 100)}% off the sticker`],
          ['Open today', `${net.open} of ${net.count}`],
        ]
          .map(([k, v]) => `<span class="hero-fact"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b></span>`)
          .join('')
      : '';

    /* The terms card: the figure, the struck list price, and the three other
       numbers a buyer compares it to. */
    document.getElementById('terms-card').innerHTML = paid
      ? `
      <div class="terms-head">
        <span class="eyebrow">2026 season · January 1 to December 31</span>
        ${presaleOpen ? '<span class="chip">Presale</span>' : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="terms-price">
        ${offCents > 0 ? `<s class="was">${money(paid.priceCents)}</s>` : ''}
        <span class="amount">${money(annualNow)}</span>
        <span class="unit">per year</span>
      </div>
      ${offCents > 0 ? `<p class="price-off">Presale ends Dec 2nd, save <span class="ok">${money(offCents)}</span>!</p>` : ''}
      <dl class="ledger">
        <div><dt>Monthly</dt><dd>${paid.monthlyPriceCents != null ? `${money(paid.monthlyPriceCents)} per month` : 'Not sold monthly'}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Ride days included</dt><dd>${net.dayTotal} across ${net.count} tracks</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Included days at each track</dt><dd>${net.dayMin} to ${net.dayMax}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Free account</dt><dd>${free ? `$0 per year` : '\u2014'}</dd></div>
      </dl>
      <a class="btn btn-accent" href="#offers">Get the pass</a>
      <p class="terms-note">One rider, non-transferable. Walk-up entry, no booking.</p>`
      : '';

    /* --------------------------------------------------------- the money band */

    const maxBar = Math.max(gateHigh ?? 0, paid?.priceCents ?? 0, 1);
    const share = (cents) => (gateLow ? Math.round((cents / gateLow) * 100) : null);

    const bars = [
      {
        label: `<b>${net.dayTotal} days</b>, one at a time at the gate`,

  <script>
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
       Real data: the same public read the shipped page makes.
       /api/tracks/:slug answers { data: { track, following } }.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    const SLUG = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('slug') || '221-mx';
    const STAR = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3 2.9 6 6.6.9-4.8 4.6 1.2 6.5L12 17.9 6.1 21l1.2-6.5L2.5 9.9 9.1 9z"/></svg>';
    const DOW = ['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'];
    const WEEK = [['mon', 'Mon'], ['tue', 'Tue'], ['wed', 'Wed'], ['thu', 'Thu'], ['fri', 'Fri'], ['sat', 'Sat'], ['sun', 'Sun']];

    /* The venue mark: deterministic mirrored pixel pattern, the same read the
       app's TrackLogo/AvatarPattern give a venue with no logo file. */
    function markSvg(seed) {
      let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) { h ^= seed.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0; }
      let s = h >>> 0;
      const rnd = () => { s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0; let t = s; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const cells = [];
      const cols = 5, rows = 5;
      for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < Math.ceil(cols / 2); x++) {
          if (rnd() > 0.46) { cells.push([x, y]); cells.push([cols - 1 - x, y]); }
        }
      }
      const cell = 12;
      const rects = cells.map(([x, y]) => '<rect x="' + (x * cell + 6) + '" y="' + (y * cell + 6) + '" width="' + cell + '" height="' + cell + '" rx="1.5" fill="#ff8a3f" opacity="' + (0.55 + Math.round(rnd() * 4) / 10) + '"/>').join('');
      return '<svg viewBox="0 0 72 72" role="img" aria-label="Venue mark"><rect width="72" height="72" fill="#1f1f22"/>' + rects + '</svg>';
    }

    const fmtDay = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
    const fmtTime = (mins) => {
      if (mins == null) return '';
      const h = Math.floor(mins / 60), m = mins % 60;
      const ap = h >= 12 ? 'pm' : 'am';
      const hh = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
      /* The venue reads its own clock the way the shipped page prints it:
         9am, not 9:00am. */
      return m === 0 ? hh + ap : hh + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ap;
    };
    const eventTime = (e) => (e.startMinutes == null ? 'All day' : fmtTime(e.startMinutes) + '–' + fmtTime(e.endMinutes));

    let track = null;
    let viewMonth = null;

    function drawCalendar() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('calGrid');
      const year = viewMonth.getUTCFullYear(), month = viewMonth.getUTCMonth();
      document.getElementById('monthLabel').textContent =
        viewMonth.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });

      const first = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 1));
      const daysInMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
      const lead = first.getUTCDay();
      const byDay = new Set();
      (track.events || []).forEach((e) => {
        const d = new Date(e.startsAt);
        if (d.getUTCFullYear() === year && d.getUTCMonth() === month) byDay.add(d.getUTCDate());
      });
      const now = new Date();
      /* The venue's day is the reader's own day — the same rule the app's
         todayKey() follows, or the marker rolls over at 7-8 PM Eastern. */
      const todayKey = now.getFullYear() + '-' + now.getMonth() + '-' + now.getDate();

      let html = DOW.map((d) => '<div class="ax-cal-dow">' + d + '</div>').join('');
      for (let i = 0; i < lead; i++) html += '<div class="ax-cal-day void"></div>';
      for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
        const isToday = (year + '-' + month + '-' + d) === todayKey;
        const cls = ['ax-cal-day', byDay.has(d) ? 'has' : '', isToday ? 'today' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
        html += '<div class="' + cls + '">' + d + '</div>';
      }
      grid.innerHTML = html;

      const inMonth = (track.events || []).filter((e) => {
        const d = new Date(e.startsAt);
        return d.getUTCFullYear() === year && d.getUTCMonth() === month;
      });
      const list = document.getElementById('eventList');
      list.innerHTML = inMonth.length
        ? inMonth.map((e) => {
            const d = new Date(e.startsAt);
            return '<a class="ax-event" href="#">' +
              '<span class="ax-event-date"><span>' + d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' }) + '</span><b>' + d.getUTCDate() + '</b></span>' +
              '<span><span class="ax-event-title">' + e.title + '</span><span class="ax-event-meta" style="display:block">' + fmtDay(e.startsAt) + ' · ' + eventTime(e) + '</span></span>' +

              '</a>';

      document.getElementById('schedCount').textContent = inMonth.length + (inMonth.length === 1 ? ' date' : ' dates') + ' this month';

    function draw() {
      document.title = track.name + ' — Moto Pass (Astryx proposal)';

      const photos = track.photos || [];
      const hero = photos[0] ? photos[0].url : (track.bannerUrl || track.imageUrl || '');
      const heroImg = document.getElementById('heroImg');
      heroImg.src = hero;
      heroImg.alt = track.name + ' track';

      const thumbs = photos.slice(1, 6);
      document.getElementById('thumbs').innerHTML =
        thumbs.map((p, i) =>
          '<a class="ax-shot" href="#"><img src="' + p.url + '" alt="' + track.name + ' photo ' + (i + 2) + '" /></a>'
        ).join('') +
        '<a class="ax-shot more" href="#"><span class="ax-badge">All photos (' + photos.length + ')</span></a>';

      document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = track.logoUrl
        ? '<img src="' + track.logoUrl + '" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover" />'
        : markSvg(track.name);

      document.getElementById('venueName').textContent = track.name;
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('statusBadge');
      const tone = track.status === 'OPEN' ? 'ok' : track.status === 'WEATHER_HOLD' ? 'warn' : 'bad';
      statusEl.className = 'ax-badge ' + tone;
      document.getElementById('statusText').textContent =
        track.status === 'OPEN' ? 'Open' : track.status === 'WEATHER_HOLD' ? 'Weather hold' : 'Closed';

      document.getElementById('place').textContent = [track.city, track.region].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      document.getElementById('lede').textContent = track.description || '';

      if (track.riderMessage) {
        document.getElementById('note').hidden = false;
        document.getElementById('noteBody').textContent = track.riderMessage;
      }

      document.getElementById('addr').textContent = track.address || [track.city, track.region].filter(Boolean).join(', ');

      /* Hours: the venue's week, today marked on the row */
      const jsDay = new Date().getDay(); // 0 Sun
      const todayIdx = jsDay === 0 ? 6 : jsDay - 1;
      const week = track.hoursWeek;
      document.getElementById('hoursBody').innerHTML = week
        ? WEEK.map(([key, label], i) => {
            const v = week[key] || 'Closed';
            const closed = /^closed$/i.test(v);
            return '<tr class="' + (i === todayIdx ? 'today' : '') + '"><th>' + label + '</th><td class="' + (closed ? 'closed' : '') + '">' + v + '</td></tr>';
          }).join('')
        : '<tr><th>Hours</th><td>' + (track.hours || 'Not on file') + '</td></tr>';

      /* Reviews */
      const revs = track.reviews || [];
      const avg = revs.length ? revs.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / revs.length : 0;
      document.getElementById('avgScore').textContent = revs.length ? avg.toFixed(1) : '—';
      document.getElementById('avgStars').innerHTML = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        .map((n) => '<span class="' + (n <= Math.round(avg) ? '' : 'off') + '">' + STAR + '</span>').join('');
      document.getElementById('revCount').textContent = revs.length + (revs.length === 1 ? ' review' : ' reviews');

      document.getElementById('revList').innerHTML = revs.map((r) => {
        const ava = r.riderAvatarUrl
          ? '<img src="' + r.riderAvatarUrl + '" alt="" />'
          : markSvg(r.riderName || 'rider');
        const when = new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
        const stars = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => '<span class="' + (n <= r.rating ? '' : 'off') + '">' + STAR + '</span>').join('');
        const photo = (r.photos && r.photos[0]) ? '<img class="ax-rev-photo" src="' + r.photos[0].url + '" alt="Rider photo" />' : '';
        return '<article class="ax-rev">' +
          '<div class="ax-rev-ava">' + ava + '</div>' +
          '<div><div class="ax-rev-top"><span class="ax-rev-name">' + r.riderName + '</span>' +
          '<span class="ax-stars">' + stars + '</span>' +
          '<span class="ax-rev-when">' + when + '</span></div>' +
          '<p class="ax-rev-body">' + r.body + '</p>' + photo + '</div>' +
          '</article>';
      }).join('');

      /* Map: real Leaflet over OSM, pinned on the venue's own point */
      if (track.lat != null && track.lng != null && window.L) {
        const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: true, scrollWheelZoom: false, attributionControl: true })
          .setView([track.lat, track.lng], 12);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
          maxZoom: 19,
          attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors',
        }).addTo(map);
        L.marker([track.lat, track.lng], {
          icon: L.divIcon({ className: '', html: '<div class="ax-pin"></div>', iconSize: [14, 14], iconAnchor: [7, 7] }),
        }).addTo(map);
      }
    }

    fetch('/api/tracks/' + SLUG)
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((json) => {
        track = (json.data || {}).track;
        if (!track) throw new Error('no track in the read');
        const now = new Date();
        viewMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), 1));
        draw();
        drawCalendar();

        document.getElementById('prevMonth').addEventListener('click', () => {
          viewMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(viewMonth.getUTCFullYear(), viewMonth.getUTCMonth() - 1, 1));
          drawCalendar();
        });
        document.getElementById('nextMonth').addEventListener('click', () => {
          viewMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(viewMonth.getUTCFullYear(), viewMonth.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
          drawCalendar();
        });

        const follow = document.getElementById('followBtn');
        follow.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const on = follow.classList.toggle('on');
          follow.textContent = on ? 'Following' : 'Follow';
        });

        const copy = document.getElementById('copyBtn');
        copy.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const txt = track.address || '';
          if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);
          copy.style.color = 'var(--ok)';
          setTimeout(() => { copy.style.color = ''; }, 1400);
        });
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        document.getElementById('lede').textContent = 'Read failed: ' + err.message;
      });
  </script>

# Image storage

## Development Space

Bucket: `motopass-media-dev`
Region: `nyc3`
Origin/public base: `https://motopass-media-dev.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com`

CDN activation is not assumed. Set `SPACES_DEV_PUBLIC_BASE` to the CDN endpoint later if enabled.
Production bucket, public base and credentials are intentionally empty.

Install a limited, bucket-scoped Read/Write/Delete key as `SPACES_DEV_KEY` and
`SPACES_DEV_SECRET` in `server/.env`, then set `MEDIA_STORAGE=spaces` and restart the API.
Never put keys in client envs, Git, or chat. Partial Spaces configuration refuses to start;
it does not silently write to ephemeral disk. `MEDIA_STORAGE=local` keeps local development
working without keys. Production reads only `SPACES_PROD_*`; it never inherits development
settings. The production service remains on its existing local backend until its Space exists.
Local uploads on App Platform are ephemeral and are not durable production storage.

Keep bucket listing private. Published photos are uploaded with object ACL `public-read`;
listing permissions and object permissions are independent. Limited keys cannot be combined
with an S3 bucket policy. Do not put private documents in this public-image bucket.

## Keys and stored references

Object keys use stable track UUIDs and full asset UUIDs:

- `tracks/{trackId}/banner/{assetId}.{ext}`
- `tracks/{trackId}/logo/{assetId}.{ext}`
- `tracks/{trackId}/gallery/{assetId}.{ext}`
- `tracks/{trackId}/reviews/{reviewId}/{assetId}.{ext}`
- `users/{userId}/avatar/{assetId}.{ext}` (rider profile photo)

Database URL fields retain a relative reference `/api/media/{key}` for Spaces images,
not the bucket hostname. That route redirects to the configured public base with a noncached
302. This keeps existing API/client contracts and requires no schema migration. Moving a
bucket requires copying the objects first, then changing bucket and public base together;
changing the key layout still requires updating references. Local images use
`/api/uploads/{key}`. Existing flat local paths and bundled `/tracks/...` images still work.

Uploads remain browser-to-API base64 JSON. The API verifies image content, the declared format,
and the 5 MB decoded input ceiling, and re-encodes without metadata. It retains the input
format: automatic WebP conversion/resizing is not part of this change. Captions, categories,
ordering, ownership and review relationships remain in PostgreSQL.

Replacing a banner/logo creates a fresh immutable object. The old image is removed only after
the profile save and only when no database record references it. Gallery/review deletion uses
the same reference guard. External URLs and seeded images are never deleted. Cleanup failures
are logged without failing an already committed request. Abandoned, unsaved image uploads can
remain orphaned; periodic reconciliation is a separate maintenance task. CDN cache invalidation
for urgent moderation/removal is also separate; deleting an origin object alone does not purge
already cached copies. Published objects use a one-day browser cache lifetime.

## Rider avatar

`POST /api/me/avatar` (registered as `/api/auth/me/avatar`) takes `{ dataUrl }` from a signed-in
account and answers the managed reference, which `GET /auth/me` then returns as `avatarUrl`.
Its JSON limit is 8 MB and it runs before the global parser. The previous file is removed only
after the row holds the new reference, and only when no other account uses it.

`PATCH /auth/me` still accepts `avatarUrl` as a URL and `avatarUrl: ''` clears it; both now
retire the replaced image. A shipped `/avatars/<key>.svg` is never deleted, so the demo can be
put back with `PATCH { avatarUrl: '/avatars/quinn.svg' }`.

The UI is `client/src/components/AvatarPicker` inside the Details sheet of both profile pages
(Astryx and legacy). It is not part of the name/location draft: it saves on its own and calls
`refresh()` so the header photo updates with it. `cd server && npm run verify:avatar` covers the
whole path against the live dev API (14 checks) and restores quinn's seeded avatar at the end.

## Limits and migration

Upload-specific JSON parsers run before the normal 1 MB API parser: 8 MB for one owner image or
one avatar, 42 MB aggregate for up to six review images. The per-image decoded cap remains 5 MB.

Do not move bundled hero/track/avatar assets as part of this integration. Before switching an
existing deployment, inventory and copy any surviving `server/uploads` files, update old database
references or retain a compatible serving path, then verify each migrated image. The legacy
static route does not preserve files when App Platform replaces its container.

## Verification

`cd server && npm run verify:media` exercises real local disk storage and mocked S3 command
contracts; it does not prove a real bucket upload.

`cd server && npm run probe:spaces` is the live check: it uploads a real PNG to the configured
bucket, reads it back anonymously over the public base, deletes it, and confirms it now answers
403. It needs the credentials and network access, and prints no secrets.

`cd server && npx tsx scripts/verify-track-profile.ts` covers the API end to end: upload,
the `/api/media/<key>` reference, the served image, ownership, gallery order and deletion.
Two launch-state caveats are unrelated to storage: with the presale gate armed its
venue-page reads 403, and with the gate disabled its one free-rider gate check fails.

A CDN hostname is only exercised if `SPACES_DEV_PUBLIC_BASE` points at it.

# Moto Pass

**🔗 Live:** no live link yet (private repo — local dev only)

One annual pass, many partner tracks. Riders buy a single calendar-year pass that
grants a contract-specific number of practice days at every participating motocross
track — plus a discounted extra day at every track.

Redeeming is a scan: the rider shows a live QR pass at the ticket window, the
station reads it, and the server validates the pass and decrements that track's
remaining days. Every decision is made server-side; the client never sends a
pre-computed verdict.

---

## Stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Frontend | React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + SCSS |
| Backend | Node + Express + TypeScript |
| ORM / DB | Prisma + **PostgreSQL 18** (local cluster; `db push`, no migration files) |
| Auth | Server sessions (httpOnly cookie) + role checks on every guarded route |
| Payments | Stripe Checkout + webhook (placeholder keys) |
| QR | Signed, short-lived, nonced tokens (anti-replay) |

**Ports:** API `4010` · Web `5180` (Vite proxies `/api` → 4010)

**Image uploads:** local disk or DigitalOcean Spaces, with separate dev/prod settings.
See [image storage setup and migration](docs/media-storage.md). Production Spaces settings
are intentionally empty until its bucket is provisioned.

---

## The pass model

- The **Free pass** is the default: a new sign-up lands on it and it includes no
  practice days at all. It covers the network itself — every partner track with
  its live status and hours, and the tracks the rider **follows**
  (`GET/POST/DELETE /api/me/follows`). The one paid pass is the **Moto Pass**.
- One **annual subscription**, valid for the calendar year.
- Each track has a **contract** for the season: included days (e.g. 2), whether a
  discounted extra day exists (e.g. day 3 at 50% off), how many discounted days
  are allowed, and the sticker price of an extra day.
- Contract terms are **snapshotted** into a per-user `Allotment` row when a pass
  activates, so a later contract edit never silently rewrites a rider's remaining
  days. `POST /api/admin/seasons/:seasonId/sync-allotments` pushes changes
  deliberately.
- The **Moto Pass** is the one paid tier — **$400 a year** or **$50 a month** —
  with a presale rate (25% off the annual price) that runs from **Nov 16** until
  full price on **Dec 2**.
- Every partner track runs the same offer: **two included days** per pass and a
  **third at half price**, and a track is free to offer more (a few carry an
  extra included day).

### What the free tier does not get

Included days and member discounts are contract terms, not venue facts, so the
server withholds them from a free-tier rider rather than merely hiding them in
the UI: `GET /api/tracks` nulls `includedDays` / the discount fields and sets
`gated: true` for that viewer, and the network page drops those columns, the map
popup's contract rows and the track panel's day facts to match. Anonymous
visitors and paying riders still get the full terms, and a rider on the
free tier who buys a paid pass stops being gated on the next request
(`getCurrentPass` always prefers the paid pass over the free one). The one opt-out
is `GET /api/tracks?terms=public`, which the pricing page uses: those figures are
the anonymous marketing copy, so a free rider reading it still sees them.

### Venue status

Separate from the contract: every `Track` carries `status`
(`OPEN` / `WEATHER_HOLD` / `CLOSED`), an optional `statusNote`, `hours` and the
next event. `hours` is the one-line summary ("Practice 9am–4pm") the rail, the
map and the panel read; `hoursWeek` is the same venue's whole week as JSON
(`{"mon":"Practice 9am–4pm", …}`, `Closed` on a day it does not run), which is
what the venue profile lays out a day at a time and the owner edits from the
console — one field per day. Both are in the public `/api/tracks` payload for
every viewer. This is the operational line the free tier exists for. It is not
part of a contract and is not snapshotted into allotments.

### Scan validation (`src/services/scan.service.ts`)

Order of checks, each with its own denial reason:

1. Token signature valid → else `BAD_SIGNATURE`
2. Token not expired → else `EXPIRED` (a screenshot from a minute ago fails)
3. Pass exists and belongs to the rider
4. Pass cancelled / not activated / expired → `PASS_CANCELLED`, `PASS_NOT_ACTIVATED`, `PASS_EXPIRED`
5. Already redeemed today at this track → `ALREADY_USED_TODAY`
6. Track participates in the pass → else `TRACK_NOT_PARTICIPATING`
7. Free day available → `FREE`; else discounted day available → `DISCOUNT`
   (price computed server-side, collected at the window); else `NO_DAYS_REMAINING`

Every attempt — approved or denied — is written to `ScanEvent` for the log and
for reporting.

The operator's station card carries **no camera preview**: it is a *Start camera*
button, the mode line and the manual code field. The button opens a sheet with
the live view (`components/Scanner.tsx` — `.scan-sheet` / `.scan-frame`), the
decoded frame loop, and the last outcome read back in place, so the operator
never scans blind while a result paints on the page behind the sheet. Closing
the sheet — its button, the backdrop, or Escape — stops every track on the
stream; nothing holds the lens once it is shut. The full outcome banner still
lands in the page's left column for the record.

### QR codes

`GET /api/me/qr-token` returns a token signed with `QR_SIGNING_SECRET` carrying
`{ passId, userId, nonce, expiry }`. The portal rotates it every ~25s. Because
the token expires and carries a nonce, a saved screenshot cannot be replayed.

## Payments

- `POST /api/payments/checkout` creates a `PENDING` pass + payment, then a Stripe
  Checkout Session. Early-bird pricing applies while it's in effect.
- **One purchase, one pair.** A second click (or a back-then-buy-again) reuses the
  `PENDING` pass + payment the first click left, provided it is younger than a
  day; the presale price is re-read onto the payment. So a double click can no
  longer leave two payment rows behind.
- `POST /api/payments/webhook` verifies the Stripe signature (mounted with
  `express.raw` before the JSON parser) and activates the pass on
  `checkout.session.completed`. `checkout.session.expired` retires the pair, but
  only for the session the pair currently points at, so an early abandonment
  cannot cancel a retry.
- **The return trip confirms itself.** `success_url` is
  `/tracks?checkout=success&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`; the page calls
  `GET /api/payments/checkout/:sessionId`, which reads that session from Stripe
  and completes the purchase if the webhook has not landed yet. Both paths share
  `completePayment`, which is idempotent — activating twice would snapshot the
  allotments twice. The page then re-reads `/me/pass` and says so in a banner.
  `cancel_url` is `/pricing?checkout=cancelled`, read once and then dropped from
  the URL.
- **Placeholder keys:** with no real keys the app runs in dev mode and returns a
  session id; `POST /api/payments/dev/simulate/:paymentId` drives the *same*
  completion path as the webhook so the round trip is verifiable locally. The
  pricing page then takes the same return trip (`/tracks?checkout=success`,
  without a session id). This endpoint answers 404 in production unless the
  deployment sets `ALLOW_DEV_SIMULATE=true` — which the demo deployment does,
  because it has no Stripe key and its paid CTA would otherwise dead-end.
- **Going live:** set `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` (test mode first) and
  `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in `server/.env`, then restart the API. Point a Stripe
  webhook at `<origin>/api/payments/webhook` for
  `checkout.session.completed`, `checkout.session.expired` and
  `charge.refunded`; locally, `stripe listen --forward-to
  localhost:4010/api/payments/webhook` prints the `whsec_…` to use. Prices are
  sent inline as `price_data`, so no Price objects need creating; the
  `STRIPE_*_PRICE_ID` variables are unused.
- Renewal, calendar-year expiry and cancellation are handled via
  `POST /api/payments/renew` and `PATCH /api/admin/passes/:id/status`.

## Perks

Track-agnostic discount codes attached to a pass (optionally scoped to a track or
tier). Listed in the rider portal at `GET /api/me/perks`, redeemed with
`POST /api/me/perks/:code/redeem`.

Each perk carries a **promo type** — `PERCENT`, `FIXED_AMOUNT`, `OFFER`,
`FREE_DAY`, `BUNDLE`, `EARLY_ACCESS` (`src/types/enums.ts` → `DiscountType`).
The rider's own page and `/tracks/perks` render them as a **grid of centred
cards**: the type's SVG icon with its own glow, no disc behind it
(`client/src/components/PromoTypeIcon.tsx`, one shared ticket icon), the offer title, and
a single full-width redeem action that flips to a `Redeemed` state. Neither the
promo-type label nor the code appears on the card — every type draws the same
ticket icon, so the offer title is what names the perk. `Redeem` opens a
how-to-redeem sheet (`client/src/components/PerkSheet.tsx`): the offer's own
description, the code with a Copy button, and where it is valid, with a
`Mark as redeemed` confirm that records it through
`POST /api/me/perks/:code/redeem`. Adding a promo type means one enum value, one
zod value, and one entry in `PROMO_TYPE_LABEL` (`promoTypeLabel` is currently
rendered nowhere; the map is kept as the canonical label list).

## The network page (`/tracks`) and its map

`/tracks` is a split screen for everyone: a Leaflet map over OpenStreetMap tiles
(keyless, `referrerPolicy: 'origin'`) takes the wide right half, holding still
while the left rail scrolls past it with one card per partner track. For a
signed-in rider the rail carries the pass's own terms — the days left at each
venue, the discounts, the offers — and each marker reads its access state:

The seeded partners are real, currently-operating motocross venues and each
`lat`/`lng` is the facility's actual mapped location (not a city centroid), so the
pins land on the tracks themselves.

| Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Lime | Included days left |
| Amber | Out of included days, discounted extra day still available |
| Grey | Out of every day at that track — greyed out |
| Grey, dashed | Not covered by this pass at all (e.g. no active pass) |

A visitor, or an account with no pass, gets the same network with each venue's
live status in place of the day facts, and no follow controls: **following and
booking are the signed-in-only parts**. `/tracks` replaced the old public
directory, so the contract table that used to sit under the map is gone — the
same facts live in the track panel.

Tiles are darkened by inverting `.leaflet-tile-pane` only, so markers and popups
keep their real colours. Leaflet is code-split into its own chunk, so it loads
with the first page that shows a map rather than with the app. The rows in the
rail beside the map carry every track's remaining days in text, so the numbers
are available even if tiles fail to load.

Clicking a row in that rail opens the track: the rail swaps the list for a
panel on that one venue — its photo, description, the pass's terms there (days
left, discounted day, member rate), the offers it still
carries, and the track's own site and feeds where they exist. The
map answers at the same time: the picked track's pin stays lit and every other
pin steps back. The panel's back control restores the list and the map.
`client/scripts/verify-map.cjs` drives the whole loop headlessly.

## Tables

Every table in the app sorts. Click a header to sort ascending, click it again
to flip, and the active column is marked by a drawn chevron plus `aria-sort` for

both directions, so a click never buries the rows you can act on. Columns that
are actions rather than data (buttons) stay unsortable, and

`/pricing` opens with a headed band carrying a pill toggle between the two

- **Tracks** — a partner sheet, not another column of cards: the money line

Day totals are computed from the live contracts — the sum of every track's

## Track profiles

Every partner track has its own page at `/tracks/:slug`, kept by the track's own
owner. The rail's cards and panels link to it, so the network stays the index
and the profile is the hub: the venue's photo gallery and mark, its description,
its week of hours (the day the reader is on is marked), its live status, the
schedule its owner keeps, and every way to reach it
(website, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, email, phone). The pass's own
terms there — included days, the discounted day, the member rate — follow the
same contract rules as `/tracks`, and are withheld from a free-tier rider there
too. A rider with a live pass also reads their own days left for that venue and
can book from the page.

**The schedule is a calendar, not a countdown.** It opens on the month of the
venue's next date, steps month by month with the chevrons in both directions,
and lists that month's dates beside the grid — past months included, because a
season is what a venue has on file. A date that runs more than a day marks every
day it covers, clicking a booked day opens its own date in the list, and the list
holds five dates to a page.

**The page opens on the venue's gallery.** One frame carries the block at size
and the rest sit beside it; when there are more than the block holds, the last
tile carries the count (`All Photos (8)`) and opens the full-screen viewer. The
viewer steps with the arrow buttons or the arrow keys, and closes on Escape or a
click outside. A venue with no photos on file falls back to its banner
(`bannerUrl`, then `imageUrl`); with neither, the page falls back to a plain
panel and the venue's mark falls back to the same deterministic pixel pattern the
rider avatars use.

Every seeded venue starts with five to eight real photographs of itself in
`client/public/tracks/photos/<slug>/` — taken off the venue's own website/CDN (or,
for the two venues with no site, a licensed or openly published gallery) and
centre-cropped to 1280×720. `client/public/tracks/photos/CREDITS.md` lists the
source of every frame, and `server/prisma/seed/trackPhotos.ts` (generated by
`client/scripts/gen-track-photo-seed.py`) is what the seed reads.

The owner is the **`OPERATOR` account pinned to the venue** (`User.operatorTrackId`),
so the console reads and writes only that track:

| Where | What it is |
|---|---|
| `/operator/profile` | The owner's console: profile copy, the photo gallery, banner/logo, social links, live status, and the event list |
| `GET/PATCH /api/owner/track` | Read and write that profile (`?trackId=` / body `trackId` for an ADMIN, who gets a venue picker) |
| `GET/POST /api/owner/track/events`, `PATCH/DELETE /api/owner/track/events/:id` | The venue's dated schedule |
| `POST /api/owner/track/photos`, `PATCH/DELETE /api/owner/track/photos/:id`, `POST /api/owner/track/photos/reorder` | The gallery: add (upload or URL), label, drop, and re-order |
| `POST /api/owner/track/assets` | Banner/logo upload — a data URL in, a `/api/uploads/<file>` path back |

An owner may edit the profile copy, the links, the live status line, the events
and the gallery. `name`, `slug`, `lat`/`lng`, `category` and `isActive` stay
admin-only: the slug is load-bearing across the seed and the verify suites.

The gallery's order is the row order (`TrackPhoto.sortOrder`), and the first row
is what the public page opens on — so a reorder writes the whole order back
(`POST .../photos/reorder` takes every id, and refuses a partial list). A
photo's `category` (Track / Facility / Race day) and caption are the owner's own
labels: the public grid shows the frames and the count, and the label rides along
into the viewer. A venue gallery is capped at 24 photos.

Uploads land in `server/uploads/` (gitignored) and are served back under
`/api/uploads`, which rides the same dev proxy as `/api` — no second origin, no
bucket, no upload dependency. A bare event date is stored at noon UTC so the day
never slips across a timezone. Event schedules are seeded only for the original
seven venues (mirroring the `nextEvent` line already on each of their rows); the
rest show the empty state until an owner adds one.

- **PostgreSQL, not SQLite.** The API talks to the local PostgreSQL 18 cluster
  (`DATABASE_URL` in `server/.env`); the role owns the `motopass` database and
  carries `CREATEDB` so `prisma migrate dev` can build its shadow DB. There are
  no migration files — `npx prisma db push` is the schema step, and `npm run seed`
  wipes and rebuilds the demo data. Money stays integer cents, every "enum" is a
  String validated in `src/types/enums.ts` (so adding a value never needs a
  migration), and the audit log's `meta` is a JSON string. Text search passes
  `mode: 'insensitive'` explicitly — SQLite's `LIKE` ignored case, PostgreSQL's
  does not, so the gate's rider lookup and the admin user search ask for it.
- No competitor product is referenced anywhere in code, UI or docs.
- **The legal pages are starter copy.** `/privacy` and `/terms` describe what the

  for review, not vetted legal text. The support address

The app is published to a private Tailscale tailnet — **tailnet-only, never
Funnel, never on the LAN**.

```
http://jlb-hermes.tail1caa84.ts.net:5181
```

- The API binds **loopback only** (`HOST=127.0.0.1`, default). Nothing is

- Only the Vite server is published; it serves the SPA and proxies `/api`, so the
  tailnet sees a single origin (no CORS, no extra port).
- `client/vite.config.ts` sets `server.allowedHosts` to accept the `<node>.ts.net`
  Host header.
- Managed by `~/.tailscale/hermes-remote.sh` as `hermes-remote-dialed-api` /
  `hermes-remote-dialed-web` systemd `--user` units (own cgroups, so a gateway
  restart doesn't take them down). They come back at boot with the rest of the
  stack. `bash ~/.tailscale/hermes-remote.sh status|restart|url`.

### Known limitation: camera QR scanning over plain HTTP

Tailnet HTTPS certificates are **not enabled** on this node (`CertDomains: null`),
so the published URL is `http://`. Browsers only allow `getUserMedia` in a secure
context, so the **camera** scanner will not open on a remote device. Two ways
around it:

1. **Manual entry** — the rider portal's *Show code* button exposes the scan
   token; the operator page has a *Manual scan code* field. Fully functional over
   HTTP, and it exercises the same server-side validation.
2. **Enable HTTPS** — flip *HTTPS Certificates* on in the Tailscale admin console
   (DNS page), then re-publish with `tailscale serve --bg --https=443
   http://127.0.0.1:5180`. The camera then works.

# ---- Server ----
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=4010
NODE_ENV=development
CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5180

# ---- Secrets ----
# Used to sign session cookies and QR scan tokens. CHANGE IN PRODUCTION.
SESSION_SECRET="dev_session_secret_change_me"
QR_SIGNING_SECRET="dev_qr_signing_secret_change_me"
# How long a single QR token is valid, in seconds. Prevents screenshot replay.

# ---- Stripe ----
# Placeholder keys. Replace with real test/live keys. NEVER commit real keys.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET="whsec_placeholder"
STRIPE_BASE_PRICE_ID="price_placeholder_base"

# Set only on a deployment that runs without Stripe keys (a demo): it opens
# POST /api/payments/dev/simulate/:paymentId in production so the paid CTA can
# finish a purchase. Left unset, that endpoint answers 404 in production.
ALLOW_DEV_SIMULATE=false


# ---- Launch window (the presale) ----
# ISO timestamps. While the window runs the site is in its presale phase: `/`
# serves the presale page and the network, venue pages, the season read and a
# rider's calendar/perks/follows answer 403 to visitors and free-tier accounts.
# Paid passes, operators and admins read straight through.
#   LAUNCH_PRESALE_ENDS_AT is the one value that ends it; the phase flips by
#   date comparison on the next request, with no redeploy and no cron.
# Leave BOTH unset and nothing gates — the phase is OPEN, which is what dev and
# the verify suites run on, so never set these in server/.env for local work.
# LAUNCH_PRESALE_STARTS_AT is optional; unset means the window is already open.
LAUNCH_PRESALE_STARTS_AT=
LAUNCH_PRESALE_ENDS_AT=

# ---- Mail (Resend) ----
# Signup confirmation and password reset are the two messages that must arrive.
# The key path follows NODE_ENV, the same way the Spaces credentials do:
#   development  reads RESEND_API_KEY_DEV   (this file)
#   production   reads RESEND_API_KEY_PROD  (set as a secret on the deploy)
# A process never borrows the other environment's key, so a laptop cannot send
# with the live key and a deploy cannot quietly fall back to the dev one. Both
# keys are enough on their own — no host, port or user.
# MAIL_FROM must be on a domain verified on that key's account (Dashboard →
# Domains) or every send is refused with a 403. MAIL_FROM_DEV / MAIL_FROM_PROD
# override MAIL_FROM when each environment has its own sending domain.
# Leave the key for this environment unset and the message is printed to the API
# log instead, which is what an unconfigured dev box does: the reset/confirm link
# still comes back in the response body off production.
RESEND_API_KEY_DEV=
# Production deliberately unconfigured here. Never reuse the development key.
RESEND_API_KEY_PROD=
MAIL_FROM="Moto Pass <no-reply@motopass.example.com>"
# Optional per-environment senders; either one wins over MAIL_FROM for its env.
MAIL_FROM_DEV=
MAIL_FROM_PROD=
# Optional: where a reply goes, if a rider should be able to answer.
MAIL_REPLY_TO=
# The origin the link in the message points at. Falls back to CORS_ORIGIN, then
# http://localhost:5180, so set it on any deploy with a real domain.
APP_PUBLIC_URL=

# Keep local until a bucket-scoped Read/Write/Delete key has been installed.
# Set MEDIA_STORAGE=spaces to enable durable uploads; partial setup fails closed.

SPACES_PROD_BUCKET=
SPACES_PROD_PUBLIC_BASE=
SPACES_PROD_KEY=
SPACES_PROD_SECRET=
